description: We are a group of students interested in space exploration, technology, healthcare, and engineering. We enjoy learning new things, solving problems, and working together to turn creative ideas into reality. We are looking for people who share similar interests and bring different skills to the team, especially in programming, hardware engineering, biomedical engineering, design, and data analysis.
summary: Kayath is a centralized astronaut health-monitoring system designed to bring together data from multiple health-monitoring devices used by NASA and the Canadian Space Agency. Instead of relying on several separate devices and systems, Kayath aims to combine their information into one accessible platform. It collects and organizes important health data, displays it in an easy-to-understand format, and helps astronauts keep track of their overall health during space missions. By bringing these different technologies together, Kayath aims to simplify health monitoring, make important information easier to access, and support better-informed health decisions. Our goal is to create a system that makes astronaut health monitoring more efficient, organized, and convenient, especially in the challenging environment of space.
details: BioDeck-MD is a crew health awareness console for deep-space missions, where a reply from Earth can take up to forty minutes. It watches seven body systems (mind, eyes, heart, immune, gut, bones and radiation), reports each as Stable, Drift, Act or Alert, explains the status by its symptoms, and gives exactly three actions for every alert. The crew enters readings by daily check-in, sliders, a webcam eye-tracking fatigue test or voice, and everything runs in the browser with nothing to install. Our goal is to help Moon and Mars crews notice health problems early and act on their own; it is an awareness tool, not a diagnosis tool, and all readings are simulated. We built it with HTML, CSS and JavaScript using React, MediaPipe for eye tracking, NASA's DONKI space-weather feed and GitHub Pages, with help from AI tools (Claude and Canva). Its creativity is in using the body itself as the interface, and we designed for communication delay, accessibility, privacy (camera video never leaves the device) and honesty about simulated data.
